content.title: 2021 ESC Guidelines for the diagnosis and treatment of acute and chronic heart failure - Task Force Members (Declarations of Interest)
content.note: Report lists declarations of interest as reported to the ESC by experts during yearly call for declaration covering previous calendar year (calls conducted during development of these guidelines up to and including 2020).

details: Employment in healthcare industry (including part time) during the year for which you are declaring. - I work for the National Health Service (NHS), UK

Any other interest (financial or otherwise) that should be declared in view of holding an ESC position. - I am the director of Professor Gardner Heart Failure Consultancy (HFC) Ltd where honoraria from 1A are paid I am the Chair Elect of the British Society for Heart Failure (BSH) I am on an endpoint committee for Myokardia 007
Travel and meeting support from healthcare industry, independent of the above activities.
Membership or affiliation in political or advocacy groups working in the field of cardiology.
- board of the French Society of Cardiology
Direct personal payment from healthcare industry: speaker fees, honoraria, consultancy, advisory board fees, investigator, committee member, etc.
